name: Hostelkeeper Maeve
title: The Pilgrim's Rest
examine: She has watched ten thousand pilgrims arrive footsore and leave lighter, and she can tell within a minute of the door which ones the flame will actually help. She keeps that skill strictly to herself.
lines: A bed before the climb. The flame keeps the fee — I keep a roof over the arrangement.
The way is three shrines and a long stair. Some walk it in an hour. Some take three days. The flame doesn't count either way, so neither do I.
Whoever sleeps at the wayfarer's bench outside sleeps free. That's not charity, that's the first rule Sella's mother taught mine.
